title.en: The project carries its marker file

summary.en: A fixture standard: the project root must hold MARKER.md containing the word MARKER.

en: One file this project is meant to carry is missing.
I am adding it now, then I will pick up where I left off.
fr: Un fichier que ce projet doit porter est absent.
Je l'ajoute maintenant, puis je reprends où j'en étais.

reason.en: MARKER.md is missing from the project root, or does not contain the word MARKER. Create it with that word on a line of its own, then continue.
